errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос съдържа три категории: "Баскетбол", "Песни" и "Филми".
errors.evidence: The horizontal axis represents the quantitative values (percentages), not the categories. The categories are listed on the vertical axis.
The vertical axis lists the categories ("Basketball", "Songs", "Movies"), it does not represent the values.

errors.text_span: в низходящ ред спрямо броя на сините секции
errors.evidence: The categories are arranged in ascending order based on the value of the blue sections (74, 80, 86), not descending order.
The description does not explain what the horizontal axis represents (a scale of values, likely percentages since each bar sums to 100). It incorrectly assigns the values to the vertical axis.

errors.text_span: Die horizontale Achse stellt keine spezifische Größe dar
errors.evidence: The horizontal axis represents the quantity of cases. The length of the bars and their segments are proportional to the values shown (74, 16, 10, etc.), and each bar totals 100. Stating that it does not represent a specific size is incorrect.
The chart shows stacked bars (gestapelte Balken), where segments are placed end-to-end, not grouped bars (gruppierte Balken), where bars would be placed side-by-side.

errors.text_span: Die Balken sind in absteigender Reihenfolge ihrer blauen Segmente angeordnet
errors.evidence: The values for the blue segments, from top to bottom, are 74, 80, and 86. This is an ascending order (aufsteigende Reihenfolge), not a descending one (absteigende Reihenfolge).
